Ms Jane Graham 
Occupatioanl Therapist
Newtown Occupatioal Therapy
10 Johanston St
Newtown
20-06-2015
Dear Ms Jane Graham,
RE: Mr Barry JohnesDOB: 01-04-1974
I am writing to refer Mr Jones, a 44-year-old forklift driver, for assessment of his work place.
Mr Jones presented firstly on 21-03-2015 with back injury following lifting heavy box at work. His diagnosis was severe lower back strain after the exclusion of disc problems by X- ray. Therefore, he was given a 30-day sick leave. His management included anti-inflammatory and muscle relaxant drugs along with physiotherapy.
Mr Jones manifestations did not improve completely in the next visit. Accordingly his sick vacation was extended for another month. On 19-05-2015, He returned with complaint of continuing pain and stiffness of his back. Consequently, a modification of his drugs was recommended in addition to an extension of his leave for another month.
Today, Mr Jones experienced an increase in the range of his back movement despite stiffness. He felt his back was recovering well. He was bored and discourage and he wanted to return to work.
In view of the above, my recommendation is to allow him to return to work without lifting heavy objects with regular breaks. I would appreciate your further evaluation of his work place and the advice regarding the duties he should perform.
For any queries, please contact me.
Yours sincerely,
Doctor
